primary_diagnosis: Unstable Angina Pectoris with Advanced Renal Decline

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Progressive retrosternal chest tightness at rest, lasting 15 minutes, diaphoresis.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Aspirin 150mg daily, Clopidogrel 75mg daily, Atorvastatin 20mg nightly.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Chest discomfort stabilized with sublingual glyceryl trinitrate prn. Renal panel steady.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Added Carvedilol 6.25mg BID (hepatically cleared beta blocker preferred in renal impairment).

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Lisinopril / Enalapril (angioedema and CKD-3b contraindication)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: High-risk unstable angina with advanced CKD. ACE inhibitors absolutely contraindicated due to angioedema history. Beta blockade tailored using hepatically metabolized Carvedilol without renal accumulation.

primary_diagnosis: Decompensated Systolic Heart Failure with Renal Dysfunction

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Severe orthopnea, 3-pillow requirement, elevated BNP 1840 pg/mL. Bilateral wet crackles.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Ethacrynic acid 50mg IV (non-sulfa loop diuretic substitute), Metoprolol 25mg OD.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Diuresis 3.2L negative balance, orthopnea resolved, lungs clear to auscultation.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Oral Ethacrynic acid 50mg daily maintenance, initiated Empagliflozin 10mg daily.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Furosemide / Bumetanide (strictly avoided due to severe sulfonamide allergy)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Severe congestive heart failure in sulfa-allergic patient with cardiorenal syndrome. Loop diuresis achieved using non-sulfa ethacrynic acid without allergic precipitation.

primary_diagnosis: Post-Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) Angina Recurrence

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Exertional retrosternal heaviness 4 years post-CABG. Saphenous graft occlusion suspected.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Aspirin 81mg OD, Ticagrelor 90mg BID, Nicorandil 10mg BID, Atorvastatin 80mg OD.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Angina frequency minimized with potassium channel activator Nicorandil.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Continued dual mechanism nitrate/K-ATP opener.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitors (Sildenafil strictly contraindicated with Nicorandil/nitrates)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Refractory post-CABG angina successfully relieved by dual antiplatelet regimen augmented with Nicorandil. Clear warning issued against PDE5 inhibitor co-administration.

primary_diagnosis: Symptomatic Bradycardia - Sick Sinus Syndrome

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Recurrent syncopal episodes, pauses of 3.8 seconds on telemetry.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Discontinued all AV nodal blocking drugs, implanted permanent dual-chamber pacemaker (DDDR).

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: No further dizziness or pauses. Pacing threshold 0.5V at 0.4ms.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Prescribed Losartan 50mg for blood pressure control without rate-slowing effects.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Beta-blockers, Verapamil, Diltiazem, Digoxin (strictly contraindicated pre-pacing)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Intrinsic sinus nodal failure resulting in symptomatic syncope. Permanent transvenous pacemaker implantation provided definitive therapeutic resolution.

primary_diagnosis: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (Non-Obstructive)

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Exertional dyspnea, mild chest discomfort, asymmetric septal hypertrophy 18mm.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Initiated Metoprolol succinate 50mg OD, titrating to resting HR 55-60 bpm.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Diastolic filling improved, heart rate 58 bpm, exercise tolerance restored.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Maintained high-dose beta-blocker.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Digoxin (positive inotrope contraindicated in HCM)
High-dose vasodilators
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy managed with negative inotropic beta blockade to lengthen ventricular diastolic relaxation and fill times.

primary_diagnosis: Vasospastic (Prinzmetal) Angina

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Early morning rest chest pain at 4 AM, transient ST elevation on ECG with normal coronary arteries.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Diltiazem 180mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg nightly, sublingual NTG as rescue.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: No early morning awakening with chest tightness. Vasospasms abolished.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Avoided all non-selective beta-blockers which provoke alpha-adrenergic spasm.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Propranolol / non-selective beta-blockers (provoke unopposed coronary alpha-vasoconstriction)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Coronary vasospasm confirmed with transient ischemic ST shifts. Abolished using high-affinity calcium channel antagonist dual therapy.

primary_diagnosis: Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy (Stress-Induced Apical Ballooning)

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Acute substernal chest pain after severe emotional bereavement. LVEF 30% with apical ballooning.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Carvedilol 3.125mg BID, low-dose Lisinopril 2.5mg OD, supportive cardiac care.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Repeat echocardiogram shows dramatic recovery of apical contractility; LVEF 55%.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Tapering ACE-inhibitor, maintained low-dose beta blocker for sympathetic modulation.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Exogenous catecholamines (Epinephrine / Dopamine contraindicated)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Transient catecholaminergic neurocardiogenic stunning with complete myocardial recovery following short-term neurohormonal blockade.

primary_diagnosis: Diabetic Nephropathy Stage 3b with CKD-Related Fluid Retention

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Peripheral pitting edema (+2), nocturnal cough, eGFR 36 mL/min, creatinine 1.9 mg/dL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Bumetanide 1mg daily, Losartan 25mg daily, Febuxostat 40mg daily.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Edema resolved, breathing comfortably, renal values stable at eGFR 36.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Maintained low-dose loop diuretic and ARB with strict serum potassium oversight.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Allopurinol (dose reduction needed, Febuxostat preferred with preserved hepatic clearance)
Metformin
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Proteinuric diabetic renal disease complicated by recurrent hyperuricemia. Volume control established with bumetanide while febuxostat safely controlled urate without allopurinol hypersensitivity risks.

primary_diagnosis: ANCA-Associated Vasculitis (Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis - Renal Limited)

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Rapidly progressive renal decline: creatinine 3.6 mg/dL from baseline 1.1. PR3-ANCA positive 120 IU/mL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: IV Methylprednisolone 500mg daily x 3 days, Rituximab 375 mg/m2 weekly infusion x 4.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Halt of renal decline: creatinine improved to 2.1 mg/dL. Microscopic hematuria clearing.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Oral Prednisone taper, Atovaquone for Pneumocystis jirovecii prophylaxis (avoiding Bactrim due to sulfa allergy).

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole (severe sulfa allergy)
Cyclophosphamide (avoided in favor of Rituximab)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Pauci-immune necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis. CD20 B-cell depletion via Rituximab induced rapid remission and salvaged kidney function.

primary_diagnosis: Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 4 with Metabolic Acidosis

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Generalized malaise, tachypnea, serum bicarbonate 15 mEq/L (acidotic).
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Initiated Sodium Bicarbonate 650mg TID orally.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Bicarbonate normalized to 22 mEq/L, fatigue improved, muscle protein catabolism mitigated.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Maintained oral alkali supplementation with sodium and volume monitoring.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Potassium citrate (risk of inducing hyperkalemia in CKD 4)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Chronic metabolic acidosis in pre-dialysis nephropathy corrected with oral bicarbonate to preserve remaining nephron mass and forestall uremic muscle wasting.

primary_diagnosis: Minimal Change Disease in Adult Presenting with Full Nephrotic Syndrome

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Sudden onset full-body edema, 24-hr urine protein 9.2 grams, serum albumin 1.8 g/dL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Oral Prednisone 1 mg/kg/day (60mg daily), Pantoprazole 40mg daily.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Complete resolution of proteinuria (0.15 g/24h), serum albumin recovered to 3.8 g/dL. Edema gone.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Commenced planned 16-week corticosteroid taper schedule.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: NSAIDs (risk of acute kidney injury and relapse)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Adult minimal change disease manifesting with profound podocytopathy. Highly steroid-sensitive with rapid complete biochemical remission.

primary_diagnosis: Post-Renal Obstructive Uropathy with Hydronephrosis

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Lower abdominal fullness, anuria for 12 hours. Bladder scan 950 mL. Creatinine 3.8 mg/dL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Emergency Foley catheterization: 1200 mL drained immediately. Monitored for post-obstructive diuresis.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Post-obstructive polyuria managed with 0.45% Saline volume replacement. Creatinine dropped to 1.3 mg/dL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Arranged elective transurethral resection / urological stenting.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Anticholinergics (Oxybutynin contraindicated due to worsening urinary retention)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Acute post-renal azotemia completely reversed upon immediate relief of urinary tract outflow obstruction.

primary_diagnosis: Drug-Induced Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN)

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Low-grade fever, maculopapular rash, eosinophiluria following Omeprazole treatment. Creatinine 2.8 mg/dL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Immediately stopped Omeprazole, initiated oral Methylprednisolone 32mg daily.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Fever and rash subsided. Creatinine restored to baseline 1.1 mg/dL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Substituted PPI with Famotidine 20mg daily for acid suppression; tagged PPI allergy permanently.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Proton Pump Inhibitors (class effect contraindication due to biopsy-proven AIN)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Proton pump inhibitor-induced tubulointerstitial inflammation resolved swiftly following culprit drug withdrawal and short steroid pulse.

primary_diagnosis: Renal Transplant Recipient - Maintenance Immunosuppression Management
comorbidities: End-Stage Renal Disease status-post deceased donor transplant (2 years)

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Routine transplant clinic follow-up. Stable allograft function: creatinine 1.2 mg/dL. Tacrolimus trough 6.2 ng/mL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Maintained Tacrolimus 2mg BID, Mycophenolate Mofetil 750mg BID, Prednisone 5mg daily.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Zero rejection episodes, BK virus PCR negative, CMV PCR undetectable.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Continued standard triple immunosuppression regimen.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Grapefruit juice, St. John's Wort, Ketoconazole (uncontrolled CYP3A4 interactions)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Stable renal allograft maintained on target therapeutic calcineurin inhibitor blood levels with strict avoidance of CYP3A4 perturbing agents.

primary_diagnosis: Uncontrolled Type-2 Diabetes with Microvascular Complications

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Tingling in feet, polyuria, HbA1c 9.5%, fasting blood sugar 225 mg/dL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Initiated Empagliflozin 10mg daily, Linagliptin 5mg daily, Pregabalin 50mg nightly.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Fasting blood sugar down to 134 mg/dL. Burning pain in feet improved by 60%.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Maintained SGLT2i + DPP4i cardiorenal combination without renal adjustment requirement.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Metformin in full doses (dose reduction or withholding recommended as eGFR nears 30)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Diabetic triopathy under control with SGLT2 inhibitor and non-renally cleared DPP-4 inhibitor, protecting nephron filtration without causing hypoglycemia.

primary_diagnosis: Cushing's Disease (ACTH-Secreting Pituitary Microadenoma)

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Moon facies, buffalo hump, purple abdominal striae, 24-hr urinary free cortisol 320 mcg/day (elevated).
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Initiated Ketoconazole 200mg TID (steroidogenesis inhibitor) bridging to pituitary surgery.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Urinary cortisol reduced to 95 mcg/day. Blood pressure improved to 136/84.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Scheduled endonasal transsphenoidal pituitary microadenomectomy.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Metyrapone if severe hirsutism (Ketoconazole preferred in female due to antiandrogenic effect)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Hypercortisolemia medically controlled prior to definitive sellar surgery, lowering perioperative morbidity.

primary_diagnosis: Primary Hyperaldosteronism (Conn's Syndrome)

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Persistent muscle cramps, resistant BP on 4 drugs. Serum potassium 2.9 mEq/L, Aldosterone-to-Renin Ratio 48.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Spironolactone 100mg daily, Potassium Chloride 20 mEq BID, adrenal CT scheduled.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Muscle cramps resolved, potassium normalized to 4.4 mEq/L. Blood pressure lowered to 134/82 mmHg.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: CT showed left adrenal 1.4cm nodule; patient opted for medical therapy over surgery.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Thiazide diuretics (exacerbate severe hypokalemia in hyperaldosteronism)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Mineralocorticoid excess syndrome responsive to competitive aldosterone receptor blockade, restoring normokalemia and normotension.

primary_diagnosis: Postpartum Thyroiditis - Transient Hypothyroid Phase

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Profound fatigue, mood changes, milk supply reduction. TSH 18.2 mIU/L, Free T4 0.6 ng/dL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Levothyroxine 50 mcg daily, plan for reassessment in 6 months for recovery.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Fatigue alleviated, nursing well, mood stabilized. TSH down to 2.4 mIU/L.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Maintained low-dose replacement with planned trial of discontinuation at 1 year postpartum.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Antithyroid drugs (Methimazole contraindicated in hypothyroid destructive thyroiditis)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Transient lymphocytic thyroiditis following childbirth safely bridged with physiological levothyroxine replacement.

primary_diagnosis: Hyperuricemia and Severe Tophaceous Gout in Renal Insufficiency

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Exquisite pain and swelling in 1st metatarsophalangeal joint and olecranon bursa tophi. Serum urate 10.4 mg/dL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Colchicine 0.5mg OD (dose adjusted for renal clearance), Febuxostat 40mg daily.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Acute flare resolved, serum uric acid dropped to 5.2 mg/dL (below 6.0 target).
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Maintained Febuxostat and renal-dosed Colchicine flare prophylaxis for 6 months.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Allopurinol (HLA-B*5801 allele present - risk of fatal DRESS syndrome)
Indomethacin / NSAIDs
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Tophaceous gout in allopurinol-contraindicated renal patient treated effectively with non-purine xanthine oxidase inhibitor Febuxostat.

primary_diagnosis: Secondary Hyperparathyroidism of Renal Origin with Adynamic Bone Risk

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Serum Calcium 9.6 mg/dL, Phosphorus 5.8 mg/dL, intact PTH 380 pg/mL.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Lanthanum carbonate 500mg TID with meals, Paricalcitol 1 mcg three times weekly.

longitudinal_timeline.symptoms: Phosphorus controlled to 4.2 mg/dL, PTH lowered to 160 pg/mL without hypercalcemia.
longitudinal_timeline.intervention: Continued selective vitamin D receptor activator Paricalcitol to minimize hypercalcemic risk.

adverse_or_contraindicated_drugs: Calcium carbonate megadoses (promotes vascular and valvular calcification)
treatment_outcome.clinical_notes_raw: Renal osteodystrophy management using non-calcium phosphate chelator and selective VDR activator, avoiding cardiovascular calcification.
